scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity scheme is an initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2018.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to working women and wives of male workers during maternity.

The scheme aims to support women in the workforce by alleviating the financial burden associated with maternity.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at INR 30,000.

This amount is intended to cover medical expenses and other costs incurred during pregnancy and childbirth.

The scheme targets women who are registered as workers under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

Eligible beneficiaries must be working women or the wives of male workers who are employed in the organized sector.

To qualify for this scheme, the applicant must be at least 18 years of age.

There is no specific upper age limit mentioned for eligibility.

The applicant's family income should not exceed INR 3 lakh per annum.

This income criterion ensures that the benefits are directed towards those who are in genuine need of financial assistance.

The application process is straightforward and designed to be user-friendly.

Interested candidates must fill out the application form available on the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website.

The application form requires personal details such as name, age, address, and employment details.

Applicants must also provide proof of their employment status.

This can include documents like a salary slip or an employment certificate from their employer.

In addition to employment proof, applicants must submit a copy of their Aadhaar card.

The Aadhaar card serves as a valid identity proof and is mandatory for the application.

The application must also include a medical certificate confirming the pregnancy.

This medical certificate should be issued by a registered medical practitioner.

Once the application form is completed and all documents are gathered, the applicant must submit them to the nearest Labour Welfare Office.

The submission can be done in person or through an online portal if available.

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the designated officials.

The processing time for applications is typically around 30 days.

Upon approval, the financial assistance of INR 30,000 will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

The disbursement is usually made in a single installment.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board conducts regular outreach programs to inform potential beneficiaries about this scheme.

These programs are aimed at increasing awareness among working women and their families.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote women's health and welfare in Haryana.

The Haryana government has been actively working towards improving maternal health outcomes in the state.

This scheme complements other health initiatives aimed at reducing maternal and infant mortality rates.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is the implementing authority for this scheme.

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is available on the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

In addition to the financial assistance, the scheme also aims to promote the importance of maternal health.

It encourages women to seek prenatal and postnatal care from qualified healthcare providers.

The scheme is designed to empower women by providing them with the necessary resources during a critical phase of their lives.

The Haryana government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to supporting working women in the state.

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of women each year.

Statistical data from previous years indicates that the scheme has positively impacted maternal health in Haryana.

The initiative has also contributed to increasing the number of women who seek medical care during pregnancy.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board regularly monitors the implementation of the scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to assess the effectiveness of the program.

The government aims to make necessary adjustments based on this feedback to improve the scheme.

The Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity scheme is a vital step towards gender equality in the workplace.

It recognizes the dual role of women as workers and caregivers.

By providing financial support, the scheme helps women balance their professional and personal responsibilities.

The Haryana government is committed to creating a supportive environment for working women.

This initiative is part of a larger framework of policies aimed at enhancing women's rights and welfare in the state.

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders including women's rights organizations.

These organizations have praised the government for taking steps to address the challenges faced by working women.

The scheme is an essential tool in promoting women's empowerment in Haryana.

It aligns with national policies aimed at improving women's health and economic status.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to advocate for the rights of women workers.

The government is also exploring additional measures to further support working women in the future.

The Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity scheme is a crucial initiative that addresses the specific needs of women during maternity.

It provides them with the financial support necessary to ensure a safe and healthy pregnancy.

This scheme is a testament to the Haryana government's commitment to improving the lives of women in the state.
